Description: The visitor is stranded outside the villa in a heavy storm due to a vehicle breakdown, and is guided by Person No. 11 to reach the villa entrance for the first time.
Location: Quail Lane (Quail Lane)
Key Information:
  - The scene takes place amid continuous heavy rain and thunder, with loud surroundings and restricted movement.
  - The visitor’s vehicle cannot continue due to a malfunction and can only remain where it is.
  - Person No. 11 confirms they have long served Rupert Galley as his servant.
  - The visitor clearly states they came because they received an invitation, but does not know the inviter’s true intentions.
  - Thunder is marked as an environmental clue that can reappear in other scenes.
  - Person No. 11 mentions that there are other guests in the villa that night.
  - During a later search of the bodies, this invitation was found, and its detailed contents are recorded in the file '00-invitation'.
  - The visitor ultimately walks up the steps alone and knocks on the villa’s front door, entering the interior.
Characters:
  [John Hobbes (John Hobbes)] Person No. 1, the visitor.
    · Attempts to continue the journey in severe weather but fails; the vehicle will not start.
    · Confirms he is heading to the Galley Villa because he received an invitation.
    · Clearly states that he is not a friend of the Galley family.
    · After Person No. 11 leaves, he walks up the steps alone and knocks on the villa’s front door.
  [Person No. 11] Rupert Galley’s servant, who has worked at the Galley Villa for a long time.
    · Confirms that they have served Rupert Galley since they can remember.
    · Helps the visitor confirm that the vehicle can no longer proceed.
    · Guides the visitor to walk to the villa and points out the Entrance (Entrance).
    · Mentions that multiple guests will be present at the villa that night.
    · Leaves the visitor after arriving at the villa entrance.
